text: ISensor(ABC) — read-from-environment contract. abstractmethods: sense, get_sensor_schema. attr id. The perceiving side of a tool. Realized by all concrete tools (filesystem/rag/session).
IActuator(ABC) — act-on-environment contract. abstractmethods: get_actuator_schema, validate, act. validate-before-execute gate. The acting side of a tool. Realized by all concrete tools.

IToolRegistryPartner(ABC) — registry contract seen by controller/TUI. abstractmethods: list_sensors, list_actuators, get_spec, health_check. MVC++ dependency inversion: depend on ABC, not ToolRegistry.
ToolSpec — unified serializable tool descriptor (single source of truth). kind: SENSOR|ACTUATOR|HYBRID. Stored by registry; lets controller/TUI reason about tools without the concrete objects.

ToolRegistry(IToolRegistryPartner) — Model-layer tool catalog. O(1) dict lookup. Owns registration, enablement, health, safe execution (validate+act). Upgrades same-id sensor+actuator to HYBRID. Agent+controllers reach tools via this, through the ABC.

FileSystemTool(ISensor,IActuator) — hybrid sandboxed file CRUD. id=filesystem. sense=sandbox listing, act=create/read/update/delete. Path-containment guarded; scan capped. The agent's filesystem senses+acts.
RagSensorTool(ISensor,IActuator) — hybrid, id=rag_query. sense=RAG availability, act=query knowledge base. Deferred RAG wiring. feature_002 integration: agent reaches Rag via EXECUTE_TOOL.
SessionTool(ISensor,IActuator) — hybrid, id=session. sense=session meta, act=persist|restore snapshot. Delegates to Agent.persist/resume_session. Session lifecycle as a tool.
ToolRegistry --|> IToolRegistryPartner (realization). Controller+TUI depend on the ABC, not the concrete registry — MVC++ dependency inversion at the tool-catalog boundary.
concrete tools (FileSystemTool,RagSensorTool,SessionTool) --|> ISensor + IActuator (hybrid: one object realizes both). Registry marks kind=HYBRID. Hybrid pattern = same tool perceives+acts.

Agent --composes--> ToolRegistry. Agent owns tool lifecycle: registers builtins (filesystem/rag/session), delegates execute/register/unregister/health to the registry. All tool ops route through the facade.
